independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the gap between the form's fields (the collection gap) and the absent box.

intent: Submit a set of fields together
Show server errors on the fields they name

properties.description: Errors by control name (Base UI Form errors: { name: message | message[] }), an object or its JSON in the attribute: each named control shows its error at once (its own error part, or its ui-field's) and is invalid until it changes; a submit clears them.
When the controls' own errors show (Base UI validationMode): onSubmit (after a submit attempt, then on every change), onBlur (when a control loses focus), onChange (on every change).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between the fields in u (0…8 in 0.5 steps); default the collection gap (theme gap-collection, 2u).

events.name: formsubmit
events.trigger: A submit (ui-button type=submit, Enter in a ui-input, requestSubmit()) that passes validation; values by name, as FormData would submit them (a repeated name or a group's values is an array).

events.name: reset
events.trigger: reset() is called (a ui-button type=reset): preventDefault keeps every control as it is; otherwise each returns to its default and the errors clear

content.children: Fields (ui-field, ui-input, ui-select, choice groups, choices), fieldsets and the actions (ui-button type=submit / reset).

constraints: No native <form>, inside or around it: the host is the form owner of every kit form control inside that has no native form of its own (UIFormElement submitOwner). A native <form> around the controls stays their owner instead.

A submit validates every control: the invalid ones fire invalid and show their errors, the first takes focus, and nothing is submitted; when all pass, formsubmit carries the values by name. Disabled controls submit nothing.

errors map to controls by name: ui-input and ui-select show theirs in their own error part; any other control (a choice group, a checkbox, a range) shows it in the error part of its ui-field. A change to that control, a new submit or reset() clears it.
validation-mode takes Base UI's names; outside a ui-form the kit default is onBlur. In onSubmit mode the errors wait for a submit attempt, then follow every change.

React: Form (a native <form noValidate>; one part, as Base UI) with errors, validationMode, onFormSubmit(values, details) and actionsRef ({ validate(name?) }); Input and Select inside show their name's error, a Field shows it when given name. render (an element or (props, state) => element) and className (a string or (state) => string).

avoidWhen.when: One control that commits on its own (a switch in settings, a search box).
avoidWhen.reason: A form adds a submit step; a control's change event is enough.

avoidWhen.when: A named group inside a form.
avoidWhen.reason: A fieldset names and disables a set of fields; the form owns the submit.

props: render?: RenderProp // Replace the part's element (Base UI render): an element (the part's props merge into it) or `(props, state) => element`. The recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.
className?: string | ((state: PartState) => string | undefined) // Author class, or a function of the part's state (Base UI className); added after the recipe class.
errors?: FormErrors // Errors by control name (Base UI Form errors), e.g. from a server; shown at once, cleared when that control changes.
validationMode?: ValidationMode = 'onSubmit' // When the controls' own errors show (Base UI validationMode): onSubmit (after a submit attempt, then on change), onBlur, onChange.

onFormSubmit?: (values: FormValues, details: ChangeDetails) => void // Called on a submit that passes validation, with the values by name and Base UI's details ({ reason: 'none', event }); the native submit is prevented.
actionsRef?: RefObject<FormActions | null> // Imperative actions (Base UI actionsRef): validate() every control, validate(name) one.
size?: number // Unit u in px for the form and its fields.
gap?: number // Gap between the fields in u (default: the collection gap).
